ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the lower part of the figure there are layered sedimentary rocks such as shale and limestone, and these older rock strata are obviously bent, forming a fold structure. In the center of the section there is a granite body marked with “+” symbols, and the granite body cuts into the already bent sedimentary rock layers on both sides. A diagonal fault can also be seen in the figure, cutting the existing lower rock strata or rock body. In the upper part there are relatively gentle conglomeratic sandstone and sandstone layers, nearly horizontally covering the underlying folded strata, granite body, and fault; their bottom cuts the underlying structures, showing unconformable contact. Reasoning: The lower shale, limestone, etc. formed first, indicating that in the early stage the crust subsided and received deposition; these sedimentary rocks later bent as a whole, indicating that after deposition they were subjected to horizontal compression and folded; the granite body cuts into the folded strata, indicating that magma intrusion occurred after folding; the fault cuts the existing strata or rock body, indicating that faulting occurred after magma intrusion; the bottom of the overlying horizontal strata cuts the underlying folds, rock body, and fault, indicating that after faulting there was uplift and erosion and an unconformity surface formed; finally, conglomeratic sandstone and sandstone were deposited above the unconformity surface, indicating that the place subsided again and received deposition. Therefore, the sequence of geological events here is: subsidence and deposition—compressional folding—magma intrusion—faulting occurred—uplift and erosion—subsidence and deposition.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的结构关系，再按相对年代推理：识别下部页岩、石灰岩等沉积岩层是最早形成的，因其成层且位于剖面下部，可归纳为早期下沉沉积；这些早期地层整体弯曲，说明沉积后受水平挤压发生褶皱；中央花岗岩体带“+”并切入褶皱地层，说明褶皱之后发生岩浆入侵；斜向断层切割已有岩层或岩体，说明侵入后发生断裂；上覆水平地层底部截切下伏褶皱、岩体和断裂，形成不整合面，说明此前经历抬升侵蚀；最后不整合面上方出现近水平砂砾岩、砂岩层，表示该地再次下沉并接受沉积。由此得到顺序：下沉沉积—挤压褶皱—岩浆入侵—发生断裂—抬升侵蚀—下沉沉积。

读某地地质剖面图。

<image1>

该处地质事件发生过程依次是什么？
raw_record.answer: subsidence and deposition—compressional folding—magma intrusion—faulting occurred—uplift and erosion—subsidence and deposition
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the lower part of the figure there are layered sedimentary rocks such as shale and limestone, and these older rock strata are obviously bent, forming a fold structure. In the center of the section there is a granite body marked with “+” symbols, and the granite body cuts into the already bent sedimentary rock layers on both sides. A diagonal fault can also be seen in the figure, cutting the existing lower rock strata or rock body. In the upper part there are relatively gentle conglomeratic sandstone and sandstone layers, nearly horizontally covering the underlying folded strata, granite body, and fault; their bottom cuts the underlying structures, showing unconformable contact. Reasoning: The lower shale, limestone, etc. formed first, indicating that in the early stage the crust subsided and received deposition; these sedimentary rocks later bent as a whole, indicating that after deposition they were subjected to horizontal compression and folded; the granite body cuts into the folded strata, indicating that magma intrusion occurred after folding; the fault cuts the existing strata or rock body, indicating that faulting occurred after magma intrusion; the bottom of the overlying horizontal strata cuts the underlying folds, rock body, and fault, indicating that after faulting there was uplift and erosion and an unconformity surface formed; finally, conglomeratic sandstone and sandstone were deposited above the unconformity surface, indicating that the place subsided again and received deposition. Therefore, the sequence of geological events here is: subsidence and deposition—compressional folding—magma intrusion—faulting occurred—uplift and erosion—subsidence and deposition.
